propositions: Generated configuration reference lacks user-visible descriptions for each typed dataclass field, preventing it from serving as the external settings contract.
Every emitted configuration key must have nonempty public_description metadata co-located with its dataclass field definition to keep generator introspection as the single source of truth.
The generator must be extended to require nonempty description metadata and render a Description column in the configuration reference, failing when a field lacks a description.

Each generated description must identify a user-visible effect or operational consequence and be manually reviewed against its key, type, default, and lifecycle cells, with reviewer identity and UTC timestamp recorded.

Module-size constraints require extracting low-level validation helpers to keep src/rebar/_config_schema.py below the 800-line absolute limit while preserving field markers and configuration-read gate compatibility.
